title: Numbers 1 to 10
subject: Mathematics
objective: Students count objects from 1 to 10 with Hindi instruction and Santali reinforcement.
teacherInstructionHindi: इन बीजों को गिनो और संख्या बोलो।
teacherInstructionSantali: ᱱᱚᱶᱟ ᱵᱤᱡ ᱠᱚ ᱞᱮᱠᱷᱟᱭ ᱢᱮ ᱟᱨ ᱞᱮᱠᱷᱟ ᱢᱮᱱ ᱢᱮ᱾
activity: Give each group ten seeds. Students count aloud, arrange seeds in number groups, then match Hindi and Santali number cards.
steps: Place seeds or stones on the desk and count together.
Ask one child to count in Hindi and another to repeat in Santali.
Close with a quick worksheet where students draw counted objects.

exampleQuestions.hindi: तीन के बाद कौन सी संख्या आती है?

teacherPrompt: इन बीजों को गिनो और संख्या बोलो।
